name: browser
description:
Cypheria built-in browser automation tools.

Use Browser when the user asks to open, inspect, navigate, test, click, fill, or screenshot web pages, dApps, or local development servers (e.g. localhost, 127.0.0.1, vite, next.js dev servers).

Cypheria connects directly to the built-in desktop browser webview with full CDP automation, visual snapshots, QR code recognition, and deliverable/handoff lifecycle management.

interface.longDescription: Lets the Agent open, navigate, inspect, interact with, and screenshot web pages and local apps inside Cypheria's built-in browser.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open localhost:3000 and inspect the page.
